files.name: W02-run-a-readable
files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent1024x1536 RPG RUN atlas edit, exactly4 columns by4 rows. IMAGE1 is the EDIT TARGET and every one of its16 adult human bodies and running phases must remain literally the same: same face/curly hair, small head, long slim limbs, hip height, body shape, pose, wrist/hand location, boot contacts, exact pixel position/scale, clothing colors/materials, row order, grid and canvas. IMAGE2 is the other half of the same approved run cycle, supplied only for consistent identity/cloth color; DO NOT copy its poses into image1 and DO NOT swap A/B phases. IMAGE3 is a weapon design atlas ONLY, not anatomy. Change ONLY the exposed sword held in the existing right hand into the specified sword. Keep the same practical low backward/downward running carry and original blade axis/tip clearance; the right fist must enclose the grip naturally at the same hand position, guard just outside fist, blade pointing safely away from legs. Preserve the natural left-arm swing with empty left hand. No attack, no drawing/swinging, no new gesture, no scabbard moving, no body or arm reposing to accommodate weapon. Keep real blade length approximately that of the source sword, no giant blade, no crouch or head enlargement. Match the source readable palette exactly: teal-green cape, dark cool-brown leather, grey-brown trousers, ivory sleeves, neutral steel shoulder, natural bright skin; no overall color or light change. Real leather/cloth/metal texture, no cartoon/plastic. Four rows remain down/front, right, up/back, left; preserve the exact4 phases in each source row. The head/hip height and supporting/recovering leg belong to the source phase and cannot be altered.
Genuine transparent alpha around cutouts and between limbs, alpha0 empty background. Do not introduce white/grey backdrop, floor, glow/fog, shadows, labels or grid. All hair, hand, blade tip and guard remain within each original256x384 cell with transparent separation. No neighboring fragments or broad magical aura. Preserve exact1024x1536 portrait output. No raster stretch or new camera.
Specified prop: W02 Oath sword, EXACT THIRD sword from LEFT in IMAGE3: slender straight steel blade with a fine red central etched/glowing channel, a small RED ruby at curved silver branch-like crossguard, red-burgundy leather grip, restrained carved silver scrollwork. Use this third design, not the purple fourth or blue fifth. IMAGE4 shows the already approved same W02 prop in a standing/walking hand; use only its sword appearance/connection to fist, do not copy its body/pose. Keep red detail narrow and local, no fire cloud.
This is source half A only. Return exactly its four original consecutive run poses in every direction, with sword appearance substitution only.

files.name: W08-run-a-readable
files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game locomotion sprite sheet, nonviolent carrying pose.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the frozen W07 RUN HALF-A sheet. Image 2 is the companion half only as identity and equal physical bow-length reference; NEVER copy its leg poses into Image 1. Image 3 is the equipment design atlas. Image 4 shows the approved W08 prop in hand, use ONLY the bow design, not its body/poses/background.
Change ONLY the plain bow in Image 1 into the THIRD bow from the LEFT in Image 3, the silverwood deer/vine bow with carved silver recurved limb tips, pale carved wood, a distinct GREEN crystal seated beside the leather grip. Use this exact third-column design, not the adjacent violet bow. Retain the original left-hand grip point and wrist/arm position, all fingers around the real grip, string facing inward toward the character, the right hand empty, the existing back quiver and arrows unchanged. It is low-carry running with a relaxed undrawn bow, not aiming or firing. Keep one coherent bow per person and consistent physical limb-tip distance through all sixteen cells and the companion half, approximately the full bow length of the frozen target, about70% of standing body height. Any perspective foreshortening must follow the target, never shrink into a toy in alternate phases. Crystal/framework sparkle is restrained and attached to the prop, no haze or large glow.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE LITERALLY to Image 1: identical face/age/head size, slim adult body and long legs, neck/shoulders/waist, silhouette, same exact sixteen poses, phase offsets and boot contacts, camera, pixel body scale and every position. The teal green cape, deep cool brown leather armor, ivory sleeves, gray-brown trousers, neutral steel shoulder plate, natural bright skin, stitching and realistic painted materials remain unchanged. Do not use any older stocky/chibi body.
Output exactly1024x1536 with4equal columns x4rows; rows down/right/up/left. Preserve HALF-A four consecutive original run phases in each row; this is phases0..3, not a stand or walk and not duplicated phase0. One complete isolated body plus bow per cell, no clipping or neighboring fragments.
True transparent RGBA output: every empty backdrop and gutter alpha0, retain foreground alpha and fine bow string antialiasing. NO backdrop, gray/brown wash, checkboard paint, floor/shadow cloud, vignette, divider, text, numbers, labels, panels, watermark. The only requested visual change is the decorative bow prop.
